Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.serving

Class ReplicaAutoScaler

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.serving.ReplicaAutoScaler
public class ReplicaAutoScaler extends Object
Automatically scales a ReplicaPool's replica count up or down based on average in-flight requests per replica — the "automatic scaling" piece of the Distributed Model Serving roadmap item.

Why this can honestly automate both directions, unlike ExecutionTargetManager's GPU scaling: in-flight request count is a real, directly-measured, present-tense signal — "this pool is currently backed up" is not a prediction, it's an observation. GPU scale-up needed a forward-looking signal ("traffic is about to spike") that utilization alone can't provide, which is why that class deliberately left scale-up as an explicit trigger. This class has no equivalent gap: both scale-up (average in-flight exceeds a high-watermark, sustained) and scale-down (falls below a low-watermark, sustained) are decided from the same kind of signal, so both are automated here.

The "sustained for" duration exists specifically to avoid flapping — scaling up and back down repeatedly in response to a brief burst — by requiring the threshold to stay crossed for a configurable duration before acting.

Usage


 ReplicaAutoScaler scaler = new ReplicaAutoScaler(
         pool, () -> engineFactory.create(),
         1, 8,                       // min/max replicas
         2.0, 0.2,                   // scale up above 2.0 avg in-flight, down below 0.2
         Duration.ofSeconds(30));    // sustained for 30s before acting
 scaler.start(Duration.ofSeconds(5));

    • ReplicaAutoScaler

      public ReplicaAutoScaler(ReplicaPool pool, Supplier<InferenceEngine<?>> replicaFactory, int minReplicas, int maxReplicas, double scaleUpThreshold, double scaleDownThreshold, Duration sustainedFor)
      Parameters:
      pool - the pool to scale
      replicaFactory - creates a new, ready-to-use engine replica on scale-up
      minReplicas - never scale below this many replicas
      maxReplicas - never scale above this many replicas
      scaleUpThreshold - scale up when average in-flight per replica exceeds this, sustained
      scaleDownThreshold - scale down when average in-flight per replica falls below this, sustained
      sustainedFor - how long a threshold must stay crossed before acting (anti-flapping)
